tables.name: native_powf internal logtab/exptab
tables.policy: COMMON-AD 57.2: library implementation is opaque to the derivative; use the executed pow output. A separate test-only forward trace can report lookup counts after bitwise validation against the original forward output.
tables.index_policy: The lookup index depends on active state. It is held locally for the derivative, and lookup changes require a forward-side trace; it is not a frozen coefficient.

refusal.when: Any nonzero device failure slot refuses the whole gradient; slots identify each invalid input, singular domain, nonfinite derivative or overflowing accumulation.
refusal.cleared_by: scheduler before every launch; inspect after sync

slot_meanings.cause: zero heat capacity minus gas constant
nonfinite scalar cotangent reduction or accumulation rgas
nonfinite scalar cotangent reduction or accumulation cp
nonfinite scalar cotangent reduction or accumulation p0
nonfinite scalar cotangent reduction or accumulation dt

artifact_build.floating_point: --fmad=false --ftz=false; library pow derivative uses the original forward exner post-state per COMMON-AD 57.2

alias_policy: Forward allocation aliases follow the capture. Derivative buffers for aliased fields mirror those aliases; tangent, cotangent and failure storage are otherwise disjoint.

launch_abi.compatibility: Device refusal entries use distinct int32 slots and source IDs. Binding derived topology and distinct input/output cotangents requires COMMON-AD sections 35-36 support.

branch_record_status: Both derivative entries record aggregate counts for predicates they can recompute. Native pow internal lookup slots 10-18 are unavailable in the derivative itself; zero counters there are not measured choices. A separate test-only instrumented copy of the pinned forward library may supply lookup counts only after per-element bitwise comparison of its result and the unchanged helper with the original forward output. For each stage-3 sample, the runner must bind exner from the original forward executed on that same sample, including perturbed samples, for pressure-helper counts. Aggregate counts do not establish per-element branch equality.
cotangent_accumulation: When an input has multiple contributions, sum them in a fixed order in float64 and round once on the float32 accumulate; reductions use a fixed tree.

library_math.domain: argument > 0 and finite; nonpositive input refuses in REC_POW_DOMAIN with source_id tree/src/hexcore/cuda_driver.py:1458:pow-domain; nonfinite argument, result and derivatives have separate failure slots
library_math.implementation: No library implementation text or lookup table is copied into this derivative.

seed_consumption.after_reverse: exact +0.0; slots outside the forward overwrite mask are bitwise unchanged
seed_consumption.coordination: zero-initialized per-launch completion counter; last block clears only after every block has finished its seed reads; device-scoped acquire/release counter orders all blocks before clearing
